{{Quote|Jeehd-ay&hellip;|The Flesh Raider Ravager Chieftain|<ref name="Enemy Force" />}}
During the [[Flesh Raider uprising]] on the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], the [[Hero of Tython|apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] was forced to '''fight''' a group of the native [[Flesh Raider]]s when ordered to investigate activity near the ruins of the ancient temple [[Kaleth]]. In an [[ancient shrine]] near the ruins, the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] was surprised to encounter [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Flesh Raiders, and managed to defeat the hostile natives despite their advantage in numbers. The revelation that some of the natives were [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitive, and were seemingly being trained by a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], was a prospect that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Order found alarming in light of the Flesh Raiders' increased attacks, and the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Bengel Morr]] would use these natives as [[Force Adept]]s in the coming battles.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Scouts report that the Flesh Raider forces are gathering in strength. They already control the mountains around us, and now they're invading the ruins of Kaleth. My men spotted them at the remains of an ancient shrine&mdash;close to your Jedi Temple.|Moorint|<ref name="Enemy Force" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the native [[Flesh Raider]]s of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] began striking at the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Pilgrims]] of [[Kalikori village]] more frequently and in greater numbers. The [[Hero of Tython|apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]], who had defeated a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] named [[Callef]] who had been leading the natives, had discovered that [[Bengel Morr|another individual]] was leading the Flesh Raiders while [[Raid on the Flesh Raider weapons cache|recovering weapons]] from the Flesh Raiders for Kalikori Village. Din recognized the voice of the individual from a recording, but refused to tell his apprentice anything further and took [[T7-O1]]&mdash;the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] who had taken the recording&mdash;back to the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />

==The skirmish==
{{Quote|Kill Jeehd-ay!|The Flesh Raider Ravager Chieftain directs his soldiers|<ref name="Enemy Force" />}}
[[File:Ancient_shrine_valley.png|thumb|right|220px|The small valley where the ancient shrine was located]]
[[Moorint]], the [[Scout Chief]] of Kalikori, had received reports from that Flesh Raiders had been seen near the ancient temple of [[Kaleth]]. While Din returned to the Temple to confer with the other Masters, he sent his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] to investigate the reports. Leaving the village valley, the Padawan followed the [[Elarian Trail]] to Kaleth and fought through the ancient [[Tythonian War Droid|war droids]] that still guarded the ruins. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] then entered an ancient tunnel in the cliffside, where the apprentice found a group of over a dozen Flesh Raiders.<ref name="Enemy Force" />

Clearing a path through the natives in the tunnel, the Padawan emerged in a small valley, where a single Flesh Raider stood before the ruins of an [[ancient shrine]]. Approaching the [[Flesh Raider Ravager Chieftain]], the Jedi was shocked to hear the native say the word [[Je'daii Order|Jeehd-ay]]&mdash;the Flesh Raider could speak. The Jedi Order had thought the natives were [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]], and the revelation that they were actually intelligent hinted at a greater purpose behind the Flesh Raiders' attacks. The Flesh Raider then surprised the Padawan further by [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Push|blasting the apprentice]] with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], as none of the Jedi had known the natives were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] either. Laughing, the Flesh Raider summoned four subordinate Adepts and ordered them to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Jedi. But despite the Flesh Raiders' advantages of surprise and numbers, the Padawan was able to hold the line and defeat the five natives.<ref name="Enemy Force" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Master Orgus sent us. We came as quickly as we could.''"<br />"''One of the Flesh Raiders I just fought called me 'Jedi.' He could use the Force.''"<br />"''That's troubling. If the Flesh Raiders are learning the ways of the Force&mdash;it won't be on the side of light.|Bela Kiwiiks and the Padawan|<ref name="Enemy Force" />}}
Just as the Padawan defeated the last of the Flesh Raiders, the reinforcements Master Din had sent arrived: the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] Jedi Master [[Bela Kiwiiks]] and her Padawan [[Kira Carsen]]. Kiwiiks was astonished to learn that the natives could speak and use the Force, and was further shocked when she found a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] on the Ravager Chieftain's body. However, Kiwiiks could not stay longer, as she and Carsen were being sent to the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to investigate a [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|dark presence]] the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] had sensed there. Before leaving, Kiwiiks instructed the Padawan to install several [[Security camera/Legends|security recorders]] in the area, so the Order would know if the Flesh Raiders returned.<ref name="Enemy Force" />

After placing the devices, the apprentice was contacted via [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]] by Din and summoned back to Kalikori Village.<ref name="Enemy Force" /> There, Din revealed the identity of the hooded figure: his former apprentice Bengel Morr, who had been present in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Coruscant during the [[Sacking of Coruscant|sacking]] of the capital by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire over [[3653 BBY|ten years earlier]]. Morr had been presumed dead, but he now seemed determined to destroy the Jedi Order. Din also gave his Padawan a new assignment to [[Raid on the Tythos Ridge shield generator|take out]] a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] protecting a Flesh Raider base in the [[Tythos Ridge]].<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" /> Despite the apprentice's actions at the shrine, however, Morr would use many more Force-sensitive Flesh Raiders as [[Force Adept]]s later in the uprising.<ref name="Weapon of the Jedi">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Weapon of the Jedi|Tython}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The skirmish at the ancient shrine appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. The skirmish represents the events of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class story mission "Enemy Force," where the player is sent by Orgus Din to the ruins of Kaleth to investigate Flesh Raider activity there. After fighting the Flesh Raiders at the shrine, Bela Kiwiiks instructs the player to install security devices around the area.<ref name="Enemy Force" />
